name: Safe HQ repository maintenance simulation
target: Runs the production bare-repository maintenance path against an isolated synthetic repository view and injected external Git facts; verifies dry-run candidates, the explicit expiry transaction, live-ref preservation, six-hour maintenance policy, and pack compaction.
inputs: synthetic origin/main and merged remote refs
open PR, queued train, active worktree, and expired train-ref facts
pack count before and after repack
observations: dry-run lists only expired refs as candidates
explicit expiry deletes only the expired unprotected train ref
main, open PR, queued train, and live worktree refs survive
gc.auto and maintenance.auto are disabled before measurement and packing
